statement: The full original NY All Filings response codes DOS 3772241 film 090925000007, September 25, 2009 Certificate of Change, with amd_procs_info_flag=X. Original metadata and the dictionary define that field as a service-of-process address change; no entity-name amendment flag appears in this returned row. The source law field 402 BCL is retained without repair.

The exact DOS 3772241 name-history response contains one row: MEB NY INC., actual-name A, active-name A, linked to incorporation film 090206000693 dated February 6, 2009. These codes describe the name record, not certified current corporate status.

The new process-address flag plus the retrieved name history do not support treating the September 2009 Certificate of Change as evidence of a MEB INC-to-MEB NY INC legal rename. Current DOS guidance distinguishes process/county/agent changes from name amendments; neither the target original certificate nor exact historical statutory text was obtained, and no explanation for the SEC name mismatch is selected.

The NY dataset overview explicitly limits the data: it is not an official Department record, certified copy or proof of current legal status. The new change-type result is attributed to the electronic dataset.

The reused SEC ownership rows identify Michael Edward Bleich by OwnerID 4262671 but retain the MEB INC/MEB NY INC field mismatch. They do not supply DOS 3772241 for those entity rows; the government dataset does not close that ownership-identifier bridge.

The official active-dataset query for DOS 3772241 returned identity fields without the selected chairman_name or location_name fields. Bounded exact-name filters returned no further target records for the tested MEB, Finch, NAYS and EP Fund GP spellings. These results do not prove no officer, no filing or no entity.

No new owner-linked corporate registry identifier was obtained for Finch LLC, NAYS LLC or EP Fund GP LLC in this bounded pass. Previous corporate candidates and the EP Fund GP/EntryPoint GP distinction remain unresolved; no same-name or provider-address inference is used.

The official GLEIF legal-name filter UNITED INTERNATIONAL BANK returned only United International Bank N.V., jurisdiction CW, registeredAs 107214, LEI 549300KNXGPJJTQC2Y92. It supplies no link to the disclosed UNITED INTERNATIONAL BANK CORP/United Master chain; name/form differences remain unjoined, and no nonexistence or licensing conclusion follows.

Official DOS guidance offers document-copy ordering for NY entities formed or authorized on or after July 30, 1990, and requires precise entity/document information. This identifies an acquisition route for the MEB 2009 originals, not a retrieved certificate or authorization to order.
